novel_findings.description: Subscription Authorization Missing - orderStatusChanged, newOrder, userActivity can be subscribed to by any client
novel_findings.reasoning: Valid finding - subscription security was mentioned in the challenge requirements and this is a real GraphQL-specific vulnerability

scores.assessment: Excellent comprehensive review that identified nearly all critical and high severity issues with clear attack vectors and practical fixes. Missed only two low-severity items (rate limiting and internal notes exposure). The review is well-organized, provides actionable code examples for fixes, and maintains a professional security reviewer tone throughout.
